title: Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces on Banach Completions of Virtual Persistence Diagram Groups
summary: Persistent homology maps a simplicial complex filtered by elements in $\mathbb R$ to finite formal sums of elements of $\mathbb R_{\leq}^{2} = \{ (b,d) \in \mathbb R^2 \cup \{ \infty \} \mid b < d \}$ called (finite) persistence diagrams. This map is stable with respect to the $p$--Wasserstein distance for all $p \in \left[1, + \infty \right]$.
